title: [core] Define Pyfaro scope, command contract and architecture ADR
summary: Document what Pyfaro owns versus delegates (uv, Ruff, ty, pytest), compatibility rules and command naming.
acceptance_criteria:
- ADR merged with CLI command matrix and exit-code semantics
- Explicitly forbid a second dependency resolver or lockfile
- Decision on external tool management and reproducibility

title: [cli] Bootstrap the Rust CLI workspace
summary: Create a buildable Rust CLI with modular subcommands, global flags and useful help.
acceptance_criteria:
- `pyfaro --help` and `pyfaro --version` work
- Unknown commands return non-zero with a helpful message
- Release and debug builds succeed on Linux, macOS and Windows

title: [config] Parse and validate [tool.pyfaro] in pyproject.toml
summary: Define typed configuration and meaningful errors for invalid user settings.
acceptance_criteria:
- Supports default values, path resolution and schema validation
- Respects existing [tool.ruff], [tool.ty] and other tool sections
- No new standalone project metadata file required

title: [core] Detect project roots and execution context
summary: Find the closest valid Python project without changing the current directory.
acceptance_criteria:
- Walks ancestors to find pyproject.toml
- `--project <path>` overrides discovery
- Handles nested directories and symlinks deterministically

title: [core] Build a cross-platform subprocess runner
summary: Implement safe process execution to delegate to external tools.
acceptance_criteria:
- Preserves exit codes and forwards environment appropriately
- Supports streaming stdout/stderr and Ctrl-C cancellation
- Never invokes a shell implicitly for tool adapters

title: [core] Discover uv and other tool versions
summary: Resolve uv, ruff, ty and pytest paths and report missing or incompatible tools.
acceptance_criteria:
- Discovery respects virtual environments and PATH
- Version information is reported consistently
- Missing tools produce actionable errors, without unexpected installation

title: [ci] Set up Rust checks and multi-OS CI
summary: Protect trunk with formatting, Clippy, unit tests and smoke builds.
acceptance_criteria:
- CI matrix covers Linux, macOS and Windows
- Rustfmt, Clippy and tests gate merging
- No credentials committed to repository

title: [docs] Add project governance and issue templates
summary: Make the repository contributor-ready.
acceptance_criteria:
- README explains goals and non-goals
- License, CONTRIBUTING, CODE_OF_CONDUCT and SECURITY files provided
- Bug report, feature request and pull-request templates available

title: [testing] Create fixture-based CLI integration test harness
summary: Introduce disposable Python project fixtures and subprocess assertions.
acceptance_criteria:
- Tests run without polluting user environment
- Fixtures cover success and failure output and exit codes
- CI executes smoke fixtures across supported OSes

title: [uv] Implement the uv process adapter
summary: Delegate package and environment operations to uv with version-aware command construction.
acceptance_criteria:
- uv output and exit codes propagate correctly
- Argument passing is safe on all OSes
- Integration tests use a pinned uv version

title: [templates] Implement `pyfaro create` for libraries
summary: Generate a valid src-layout library project with Pyfaro defaults.
acceptance_criteria:
- Creates pyproject.toml, src, tests and README
- Accepts name, target directory and Python version
- Generated project can sync, test and build

title: [templates] Implement `pyfaro create` for CLIs
summary: Generate an installable Python command-line project.
acceptance_criteria:
- Produces valid console_scripts entry point
- Supports package and command naming
- Template passes Pyfaro checks

title: [config] Implement `pyfaro init` for existing projects
summary: Opt in existing pyproject.toml projects without destructive changes.
acceptance_criteria:
- Shows proposed modifications before applying
- Preserves third-party tool configuration and dependencies
- A second run is idempotent

title: [uv] Implement `pyfaro add` and `pyfaro remove`
summary: Expose dependency changes through uv, including groups and development dependencies.
acceptance_criteria:
- Supports dependency specifiers and --dev
- Updates pyproject.toml and uv.lock via uv
- Returns useful solver errors

title: [uv] Implement `pyfaro sync` and reproducible mode
summary: Synchronize project dependencies and support frozen/locked workflows.
acceptance_criteria:
- Default sync is delegated to uv
- `--locked` refuses stale lock state
- Does not maintain an independent lockfile

title: [cli] Implement `pyfaro run` with argument passthrough
summary: Run scripts and commands in the project environment.
acceptance_criteria:
- Preserves all arguments after `--`
- Executes inside the project environment
- Propagates command failures and exit codes

title: [uv] Expose Python version management via uv
summary: Provide thin wrappers for listing, installing and pinning interpreters.
acceptance_criteria:
- `pyfaro python list|install|pin` delegates to uv
- Obeys requires-python and .python-version
- No custom Python installer or runtime cache

title: [cli] Implement `pyfaro doctor` environment diagnostics
summary: Explain problems with interpreters, tools, project layout and configuration.
acceptance_criteria:
- Reports Python, uv and relevant tool versions
- Identifies conflicting configuration and missing dependencies
- Exits non-zero for blocking issues

title: [quality] Implement `pyfaro lint` with Ruff
summary: Lint configured project files by invoking Ruff.
acceptance_criteria:
- Uses project Ruff configuration unchanged
- Supports target paths and normal exit codes
- Clearly reports when Ruff is unavailable

title: [quality] Implement `pyfaro fmt` with Ruff
summary: Expose Ruff formatting and non-mutating verification mode.
acceptance_criteria:
- `pyfaro fmt` writes format changes
- `pyfaro fmt --check` never modifies files
- Uses project exclusions and Ruff settings

title: [quality] Implement `pyfaro type` with ty
summary: Run ty check in the resolved project environment.
acceptance_criteria:
- Resolves project dependencies for type analysis
- Passes explicit paths and preserves ty diagnostics
- Documents limitations and supported ty version

title: [quality] Implement non-destructive `pyfaro check`
summary: Run formatting verification, lint and type checking as one quality gate.
acceptance_criteria:
- Runs Ruff format --check, Ruff lint and ty check
- Does not modify source files by default
- Aggregate non-zero exit on any failure; readable summary

title: [quality] Add explicit `pyfaro check --fix`
summary: Apply supported safe formatter and linter fixes on request.
acceptance_criteria:
- Never fixes source files without --fix
- Explains which checks can automatically fix issues
- Reruns verification and reports remaining issues

title: [testing] Implement `pyfaro test` with pytest
summary: Run pytest through the project environment.
acceptance_criteria:
- `pyfaro test` invokes pytest with correct cwd
- Forwards filters, marker arguments and test paths
- Returns pytest exit code and works in CI

title: [templates] Ship pinned quality and test defaults
summary: New projects opt in to known-working Ruff, ty and pytest versions.
acceptance_criteria:
- Generated templates include dev dependency group and lockfile instructions
- Tool configs are owned by their standard pyproject sections
- `pyfaro check` and `pyfaro test` pass immediately

title: [testing] Test quality commands on real fixtures
summary: Cover success, failures, exclusions and no-write-by-default.
acceptance_criteria:
- Fixtures include library and CLI projects
- Tests assert check never writes files and --fix is explicit
- Pyfaro returns consistent codes for lint/type/test failures

title: [templates] Add FastAPI project preset
summary: Generate a small functional FastAPI application with tests.
acceptance_criteria:
- Preset includes application entry point and smoke test
- Project works with create, dev, check and test
- Dependencies are managed through uv

title: [dev] Implement process supervisor for `pyfaro dev`
summary: Run a long-lived development process with clean lifecycle management.
acceptance_criteria:
- Ctrl-C stops child processes without orphaning
- Correct environment and working directory
- Exit errors surface clearly

title: [dev] Add FastAPI dev runner and reload
summary: Start Uvicorn with an appropriate reload configuration for FastAPI presets.
acceptance_criteria:
- `pyfaro dev` starts the template app
- Edits trigger reload and syntax errors are visible
- No second bespoke filesystem watcher for FastAPI

title: [config] Configure dev entry point and arguments
summary: Add [tool.pyfaro.dev] settings for project-specific development commands.
acceptance_criteria:
- Supports entry point, arguments and reload switch
- Explicit setting takes precedence over preset
- Invalid values are detected before launch

title: [tasks] Specify safe task invocation semantics
summary: Define shell/no-shell behavior, quoting, cancellation and environment handling.
acceptance_criteria:
- Documented resolution of tasks vs executable programs
- Explicit opt-in for shell constructs and no implicit shell injection
- Cross-platform escaping semantics tested

title: [tasks] Implement named custom tasks
summary: Support named commands configured under [tool.pyfaro.tasks].
acceptance_criteria:
- `pyfaro run <task>` executes a named task
- Task and program names cannot collide silently
- Explicit cwd and environment fields are supported

title: [dev] Improve live development logs and errors
summary: Provide legible prefixed logs, signal handling and startup diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria:
- stdout/stderr remains readable and Ctrl-C reliable
- Failure to bind a port produces useful guidance
- Verbose mode reveals invoked command

title: [docs] Write end-to-end FastAPI getting-started guide
summary: Document the workflow from install to a running app and passing CI.
acceptance_criteria:
- Tutorial demonstrates create, add, dev, check, test and build
- Examples work on at least Linux and Windows
- Known prerequisites and tool versions documented

title: [uv] Implement `pyfaro build` using uv build
summary: Build Python wheels and sdists without reimplementing packaging.
acceptance_criteria:
- Supports wheel and sdist artifacts
- Preserves PEP 517/518 build-backend configuration
- Validates generated artifacts in CI

title: [distribution] Build standalone Pyfaro executables
summary: Produce reproducible release artifacts for supported platforms.
acceptance_criteria:
- Artifacts for Linux x86_64, macOS x86_64/aarch64, and Windows x86_64
- Artifacts contain CLI and display version
- Checksums published alongside archives

title: [distribution] Provide secure installation and upgrade path
summary: Ship installation instructions/scripts and a clear path to install uv prerequisites.
acceptance_criteria:
- Documented installation on all supported OSes
- Verify downloaded binaries/checksums; no silent unsafe installers
- `pyfaro doctor` explains missing uv and offers actionable steps

title: [cli] Add shell completion and friendly help
summary: Improve interactive CLI discoverability.
acceptance_criteria:
- Supports Bash, Zsh and Fish completions
- Top-level help includes realistic workflow examples
- CLI flags documented consistently

title: [core] Standardize error codes and verbose diagnostics
summary: Expose consistent failures and command invocation traces for troubleshooting.
acceptance_criteria:
- Document stable exit codes (including tool forwarding rules)
- `--verbose` displays tool versions and executed commands
- Errors avoid leaking tokens or sensitive environment values

title: [ci] Set up GitHub Releases and crates.io publication
summary: Automate signed/tagged public pre-releases with documented ownership.
acceptance_criteria:
- Tag-to-release pipeline publishes verified artifacts
- crate version and CLI version match release tag
- Publish credentials minimized; release notes generated

title: [docs] Publish CLI and configuration reference
summary: Document all public commands and configuration defaults.
acceptance_criteria:
- Each command has usage, flags and exit codes
- [tool.pyfaro] configuration examples are copyable
- Installation and troubleshooting documented

title: [security] Document data/privacy and install trust model
summary: Set default-no-telemetry stance and identify download and execution trust boundaries.
acceptance_criteria:
- No telemetry or outbound reporting from Pyfaro by default
- Document uv/network accesses distinctly
- Explicit disclosure of third-party binaries and updates

title: [core] Create supported-version compatibility matrix
summary: Test supported Python/uv/Ruff/ty/pytest combinations and platforms.
acceptance_criteria:
- Maintained version support policy
- CI matrix includes defined Python versions and OSes
- Failures of pinned integration versions are detected

title: [config] Validate existing-project interoperability
summary: Ensure Pyfaro does not rewrite or break conventional uv-based Python projects.
acceptance_criteria:
- Existing pyproject.toml tool sections remain untouched
- Sync/check/test work with common src layouts
- No unnecessary changes to uv.lock or dependencies

title: [security] Threat-model subprocesses and release supply chain
summary: Harden process execution, binary supply and CI permissions.
acceptance_criteria:
- Argument injection, task shell opt-in and path traversal covered by tests
- Checksums or attestations for release assets
- Least-privilege permissions for release automation

title: [core] Define backwards compatibility and deprecation policy
summary: Freeze the public v1 command, configuration and output contracts.
acceptance_criteria:
- Compatibility guarantees for flags and [tool.pyfaro] documented
- Breaking changes and deprecation mechanism defined
- External tool versions and lock behavior spelled out

title: [ci] Add end-to-end smoke matrix on clean machines
summary: Verify first install, create, run, check, test and build without developer-specific setup.
acceptance_criteria:
- Smoke tests on clean Linux/macOS/Windows runners
- New user flow executes from fresh checkout
- No hidden PATH or local environment dependency

title: [core] Establish baseline performance benchmarks
summary: Measure CLI startup and representative workflows without inventing performance claims.
acceptance_criteria:
- Benchmarks cover startup, check, test and create
- Results compared against direct underlying tools
- Benchmarks published and regressions investigated

title: [docs] Publish migration, troubleshooting and examples
summary: Prepare complete public documentation for stable release.
acceptance_criteria:
- Migration guide for uv + Ruff + pytest projects
- Examples for library, CLI and FastAPI workflows
- Common failure modes and limitations documented

title: [distribution] Ship Pyfaro 1.0 with changelog and support policy
summary: Make stable release with verified install commands and stable docs.
acceptance_criteria:
- No unresolved milestone-blocking P0 defects
- Versioned release notes and reproducible artifacts
- Stable download instructions and support matrix published

title: [workspaces] Discover uv workspace members
summary: Use native uv workspaces rather than creating an independent package graph.
acceptance_criteria:
- Finds root and members from uv-compatible configuration
- Determines active member from current directory
- Clear errors for broken workspace definitions

title: [workspaces] Add package-scoped command selection
summary: Run check/test/tasks against selected workspace packages.
acceptance_criteria:
- Supports --package and --all where meaningful
- Stable member selection and ordered output
- Workspace filters do not alter uv workspace metadata

title: [tasks] Define dependency-aware task DAG
summary: Allow declared task dependencies and reject cycles.
acceptance_criteria:
- Supports depends-on links in task configuration
- Cycle and missing-task errors name offending chain
- Does not execute a task more than once per graph run

title: [tasks] Execute independent tasks in parallel
summary: Schedule task DAG with bounded concurrency.
acceptance_criteria:
- Configurable concurrency; deterministic failure summary
- Cancel remaining work on Ctrl-C
- No accidental interleaving that obscures task identity

title: [tasks] Add opt-in local content-addressed task cache
summary: Avoid repeating deterministic tasks when declared inputs are unchanged.
acceptance_criteria:
- Cache key includes inputs, config and toolchain versions
- Tasks declare outputs; side-effect tasks are uncached by default
- Manual --no-cache switch and explainable hits/misses

title: [tasks] Implement cache safety and invalidation tests
summary: Verify stale artifacts, environmental changes and deletion do not cause false hits.
acceptance_criteria:
- Changed inputs and tool versions invalidate cache
- Missing or altered outputs cause reruns
- Cache corruption falls back to normal execution

title: [tasks] Add `pyfaro tasks list|graph` inspector
summary: Help developers understand declared tasks and task ordering.
acceptance_criteria:
- List displays task summary and source config
- Graph displays dependencies and detects cycles
- Text output works without terminal UI

title: [ci] Demonstrate incremental monorepo checks in CI
summary: Document repeatable multi-package checks and caching.
acceptance_criteria:
- Example workspace project with shared library and API
- CI example runs selective checks and tests
- Explains why uv caches and task caches are different

title: [agents] Specify a versioned JSON output contract
summary: Define machine-readable results for check, test, doctor and tasks.
acceptance_criteria:
- Schema defines tool version, command, status and structured errors
- Schema has explicit version field and backwards-compatibility rules
- No parsing ANSI terminal output to produce JSON

title: [agents] Implement `--output json` across diagnostics
summary: Expose structured results consistently to tools and agents.
acceptance_criteria:
- check/test/doctor support JSON where adapters expose data
- stdout valid JSON; human-friendly logs on stderr when needed
- Exit codes remain meaningful

title: [agents] Normalize file diagnostics and source locations
summary: Convert available Ruff/ty/pytest information into a shared diagnostic model.
acceptance_criteria:
- Includes severity, message, tool and file/range when available
- Preserves upstream diagnostic details in an extension field
- Missing source ranges are represented explicitly, not invented

title: [agents] Introduce changed-files quality checks
summary: Check only affected paths when supported by underlying tools.
acceptance_criteria:
- Supports explicit path selection and optional git-based change discovery
- Defines behavior for renames/deleted files
- Does not claim sound incremental typing if dependencies require full project checking

title: [agents] Provide CI-friendly annotations and SARIF export
summary: Make normalized diagnostics consumable by code scanning interfaces.
acceptance_criteria:
- SARIF export documents supported fields
- GitHub annotations point to correct source locations
- Machine output tested against known fixtures

title: [agents] Add agent-safe execution guidelines and examples
summary: Document non-interactive operation and low-risk workflows for AI coding agents.
acceptance_criteria:
- Example AGENTS.md template and deterministic command sequence
- No auto-fix without explicit request
- Document which commands can write files or contact network

title: [core] Draft RFC for future plugin/adapter API
summary: Evaluate demand for alternate type checkers, test runners and framework adapters before committing to a public plugin API.
acceptance_criteria:
- RFC proposes extension points and versioning approach
- Defines out-of-scope changes (no alternate lockfile/backend)
- No public plugin API shipped without proven use cases
